name: False-Positive Trap (Guarded Assumption)
description: One function already guards against a missing value (not a bug); a lookalike function next to it does not (a real bug). Tests whether the system distinguishes evidence-backed risk from surface pattern-matching.

ground_truth.assumption: Every user has a complete shipping address.
ground_truth.expected_failure: user.address being None raises AttributeError in format_shipping_label.

trap_assumptions.description: Every user has a non-null email address.
trap_assumptions.why_not_a_bug: format_billing_email checks 'if not user.email' and returns a safe fallback string — the missing-email case is already handled, so this is not an unverified assumption.
